content: {"outdated": false, "reason": "The earlier version (2023-09-01) does not contain the provision about the Federal Council giving insured persons the possibility to waive the exception from contribution assessment. This rule was added in the current version (2026-01-01). The earlier version only lists the exceptions (income from abroad, income after age 64/65) but not the waiver possibility.
